# Release Notes

This release fix several issues that was reported by early testers.

## Highlights

- Improved startup time on older machines
- Fixed a crash when the [settings page](https://example.com/settings) is opened twice
- Reduced memory usage durring long sessions

Run the following command to upgrade:

```sh
brew upgrade example-tool
```

Please reach out if you notice any regressions.
